title: News of the Younger Sahibzadas Reaches the Guru

blocks.text: When the news of the younger Sahibzadas reaches the Guru, it is carried in tears and trembling speech, and those around him can hardly force the words out. (1–3)
The account turns from report to lament, describing the courtroom crime, the helplessness of witnesses, and the unbearable nature of the wound left by the children's deaths. (4–8)

Out of that grief the Guru moves toward utterance and response, and the page explicitly frames the moment as the arrival of the news of the younger Sahibzadas rather than merely one more wartime loss. (9)
